info.name: Journeys
info.summary: cluster images by time and location
info.description:
Automatically clusters your photos by time and location into journeys (trips, vacations) and creates a Photos album for each. Only photos inside your Memories timeline path are used.
**Requires the Memories and Photos apps.**
- **Journey albums:** created daily in the background (opt-in), with place-and-date names like `Iceland — Aug 12–19, 2024`. Home-aware: local days and trips are clustered with separate thresholds; adjacent trips in the same country are merged. - **Journals:** a travel diary with day entries auto-filled from your photos. Share with users for co-editing or publish to a revocable public link with route map and travel stats. - **Videos:** render a journey into an MP4 highlight reel (requires `ffmpeg`), saved to `Documents/Journeys Movies/`. Optionally weaves in short clips, with their own sound, from the trip's videos.
php occ journeys:cluster-create-albums <user>
info.changelog:
0.36.1 (2026-10-17)

  • Journals: photos shared with you (by a user, a group or a Team) now show up in the day photo picker and when a new day is filled in automatically (#43).
  • Clustering: "Include shared images" now also picks up group and Team shares, not only direct user shares.

0.36.0 (2026-10-17)

  • Video rendering: the trip's videos now appear as ~4 s excerpts that play with their own sound while the music dips smoothly underneath (#9). On by default; rendering takes about a third longer, and the personal setting "Include short clips (with sound) from videos" turns it off.
  • Video rendering: 3-photo landscape stacks stay on screen a second longer.
  • Fixed: the photo after a motion photo was cut to under a second.
  • Fixed: long videos could fail when saving and leave an empty file in Journeys Movies.
  • Changed: requires PHP 8.2.

0.35.2 (2026-10-15)

  • Fixed: occ commands register again on Nextcloud 35. Thanks to @rauchc (#44).

Full history: https://github.com/thrillfall/journeys/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
